# Futora Group

> Futora Group is a product-and-service technology company founded by Madhur Dhadve, building AI-driven software platforms across fintech, social networking, AI infrastructure, marketing, and growth services — while also offering custom technology and growth consulting to external businesses.

## Companies & Products
- FutoraOne: AI-powered social networking and community platform for creators, developers, and founders.
- Futora Finance (FutoraPay & Futora Wallet): Next-generation AI-powered fintech platform and digital financial OS with UPI payments and financial infrastructure.
- Futora AI: Core AI/ML infrastructure, automation systems, and intelligence platforms.
- FutoraLift: Performance marketing and AI growth engineering helping brands scale with data and automation.
- FutoraFlow: AI-commanded business operating system for cross-task execution and workflow orchestration.
- Career OS: Proof-of-work platform for tech internships, AI courses, and high-impact startup jobs.

## Services
- Growth Services: Technology consulting, custom AI engineering, and scaling services for partner businesses.

## Leadership
- Madhur Dhadve: Founder and Visionary of Futora Group.
